digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Several follow-ups carry into tomorrow. The dashboard's completion information was last updated November 16, so please verify their current status.

items.label: Confirm Wave 2 recovery and coverage
items.detail: Jenn reports only two of nine virtual queues deployed; the rest are paused until the week of November 30 while user configurations are corrected. Confirm the recovery plan and support coverage with Thiago. Friday's Tier 2 routing issue prompted a temporary return to RingCentral.

items.label: Check MHE approvals and pilot readiness
items.detail: Mar says the pilot has moved pending provider onboarding and a new date will be set November 25. Written approvals or comments from the named recipients are due November 24; check status with Mar, including Shane's provider emails due November 23.

items.label: Follow up on the Power BI assignment
items.detail: The November 5 reporting request was unassigned and blocking the project for selling services to leads with ongoing cases. Check the request sent to Matthew; Leandro and Kevin were waiting for an assignment.

items.label: Follow up on EKM dependencies and timing
items.detail: Pilot stories passed grooming, but Legal capacity, approval governance, Salesforce migration and delivery dates remain open. Confirm ownership and timing ahead of the pilot.

items.label: Confirm Universal Intake project leadership
items.detail: Leo and Matthew are now named sponsors; confirm the project lead. The charter is due November 25, and automatic eligibility remains an open decision for Legal, IT and Intake.

items.label: Check the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: Saturday's notice identifies overdue Dominican Republic harassment prevention training and a new LeadUp Module 4A survey. Confirm their current status in Rippling; the dashboard state may not reflect recent completion.

items.label: Finalize Monday's portfolio update
items.detail: Coordinate with the other managers for Eugenia's send. Sara asks the team to flag major initiative changes and check RevCloud timing with Shannon and Staff Aug UAT with Yuri.

items.label: Check the RFE MHE decision with Mar
items.detail: Mar plans to ask Angel and Jill on November 23 whether MHE is mandatory for RFE cases. The answer determines the Phase 2 task set; IT delivery dates and a developer remain unconfirmed.

items.label: Follow up on the client SMS investigation
items.detail: Jean asked the EPMO team about texts requesting the last four credit card digits. IT and the business team are checking whether the messages were sent by the firm.

items.label: Agentforce will be tracked as green
items.detail: Nadia and Nicolas agreed to track the project as green and set a baseline once the readiness items are complete; EKM must launch first.
